question: Is the existing conditional daily quantity proxy accurate enough on one fixed seven-interval expert path to justify cheap selector screening?
data_role: SEEN_DEVELOPMENT_SEMANTIC_CALIBRATION_ONLY; no new validation or locked data
selection: First calendar date of original registered 2024 window, not selected by PnL. Original daily targets exact prefix; seven delayed owned intervals, eighth daily target zero and actual paid exit.
cost: Unchanged native fee5.5bp + halfspread4bp + slippage4bp each way; proxy linear mid-notional cost13.5bp is explicitly approximate. Binance USD-M/Bybit fees proxy, no new fee interpretation.
threshold_reason: Absolute net error <=5USDT/10k (5bp) in both conditional funding units is a preliminary screen tolerance only. At a future20bp utility separation this could still be25% error; passing is not label equivalence or investment evidence.
label_semantics: Compare existing zero-entry seven-interval paid-flat proxy and native paid-flat account. Marked proxy reported separately. Future selector labels NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN; no weekly forced-close training labels adopted.
feedback_clock: decision+7d+60,000,001us execution endpoint; label available endpoint+1us. At next weekly00:00 prior-week result not available.
first_switch: Diagnostic only: reference entry cost replaced by actual current-to-net-composite target cost once; CASH exit is not free; nonlinear NAV/partial-fill paths require actual wallet.
known_differences: Native freezes quantity at decision NAV and completed close with0.99 buffer; proxy targets at execution boundary NAV/open without buffer.
Native fee is based on directional fill price; daily proxy linear mid-cost omits fee/execution cross term.
Minute risk, precision, capacity, partial fills, mark and liquidation are absent in daily proxy; unchanged native path retains them.
stop: No alternate windows, cost tuning, horizon scan or model fits. If net calibration fails in either unit, repair action/label alignment before fits. If passes, retain proxy only for limited seen-development screening; marked/current-position/soft mixture labels still need preregistration.
limitations: One fixed already-seen week cannot validate error stability, ranking fidelity or annual return.
This is Binance USD-M with Bybit fee assumptions, not native Bybit evidence; funding units remain conditional1/.01.
Closed calibration does not certify marked continuation utility, exact current-position switch cost, intraminute risk caps or future selector efficacy.
No new strategy adopted; original losing windows and full recipe pause preserved.
